slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: topics
slots.about: 2 to 4 filter chips sharing one row: id (1 up), name; the first one starts picked

slots.name: shows
slots.about: the sources: id, name, topic (a topic id), on (followed at the start)

slots.name: items
slots.about: the feed: id, show (a show id), title, date, minutes

slots.name: min_word
slots.about: after the minutes in a row's meta line, e.g. ' min'

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: shown in place of the feed when the picked topic has nothing

slots.name: follow_word
slots.about: spoken before a show's name on its follow button while not followed

slots.name: unfollow_word
slots.about: spoken before a show's name on its follow button while followed

slots.name: play_word
slots.about: spoken before a row's title on its play button

slots.name: pause_word
slots.about: spoken before a row's title on its play button while it plays

slots.name: queue_word
slots.about: spoken before a row's title on its queue button

slots.name: unqueue_word
slots.about: spoken before a row's title on its queue button once queued

empty.shows: empty in place of rows; shelf hidden when the topic has no source

attention.shows: the playing row's play button filled with a pause icon

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap
